description: Get one batch run by `id` (from listBatchRuns), with per-test detail: `testRuns`, one row per test run it started (id, type param or mission, configId, status, outcome, times), and `configs`, one entry per batch member with its latest attempt and every attempt across re-runs. A re-run links back by parentBatchRunId and rootBatchRunId; `effective` is the summary counting each member's latest attempt. Use when: the user asks which tests failed in a batch, or whether a re-run fixed them. For why one test failed use getRunResults (or getMissionTestRun for a mission member) with its run id. Read-only. Needs testing:read. Returns 404 if the run is not in your workspace.
name: getBatchRun

allOf.description:
One execution of a `TestBatch` — one `TestRun` per `testConfigId`. The status
cycles `pending → running → (completed | partial | failed)` based on the aggregate
of the child `TestRun` rows.

summary.description: Roll-up counters for a batch run.

testRunIds.description: TestRun IDs created by this batch (one per `testConfigId`).

triggeredBy.description: `rerun` for a batch run created by `POST /testing/batch-runs/{id}/rerun`.

childBatchRunIds.description: Re-runs of this batch run. Empty when there are none.

childRuns.description: Present when the run has re-runs. One summary per re-run.

summary.description: Roll-up counters for a batch run.

configs.description:
One entry per batch member, in first-dispatched order, carrying every
attempt at it across this run and its re-runs.

items.description:
One batch member across a batch run and its re-runs. Keyed by member, `type`
plus `configId`: the param and mission id spaces are separate, so the same id
can appear once as each type.

attempts.description: Every attempt, newest first. `latest` is the first.

items.description: One run of a batch member, tagged with the batch run that produced it.

admission.description:
`queued` while a mission member waits for a free mission slot; its `status`
stays `pending`. Absent for every other run.

batchRunId.description: The batch run, original or a re-run, that created this attempt.

outcome.description: The run's outcome, with the values `TestRun.outcome` takes.

status.description: The run's status, with the values `TestRun.status` takes.

latest.description: One run of a batch member, tagged with the batch run that produced it.

admission.description:
`queued` while a mission member waits for a free mission slot; its `status`
stays `pending`. Absent for every other run.

batchRunId.description: The batch run, original or a re-run, that created this attempt.

outcome.description: The run's outcome, with the values `TestRun.outcome` takes.

status.description: The run's status, with the values `TestRun.status` takes.

testConfigId.description: Equal to `configId` on param entries, kept for existing clients. Absent on mission entries.

effective.description: Roll-up counters for a batch run.

parentBatchRunId.description: Present on a re-run. The batch run it re-ran.

rootBatchRunId.description: Present on a re-run. The original batch run at the head of the chain.

testRuns.description: One entry per `TestRun` this batch run created.

items.description:
A child `TestRun` of a batch run. Param runs carry `testConfigId`; mission runs
carry only `configId`. `configId` is the member's config id for both.

admission.description: `queued` while a mission member waits for a free mission slot. Absent otherwise.

configId.description: The member's config id, a `TestConfig` for param or a `MissionTestConfig` for mission.

outcome.description: The run's outcome, with the values `TestRun.outcome` takes. Absent until it finishes.

status.description: The run's status, with the values `TestRun.status` takes.

testConfigId.description: The param test config. Absent on mission runs.

outputSchema.description:
Variant returned by `GET /testing/batch-runs/{id}` — the batch run plus inlined
detail for each constituent `TestRun`, and a per-member view that folds in the
attempts from every re-run of it.

title: Get Batch Run
